name: Yang-Mills Paper IX
prompt: Fix the layout of the paper in {root}/paper/ so every equation and figure fits on the page, then rebuild the PDF at {target}. Never delete a section; comment it out if it must go. Derive each result you touch; do not assert it. Show the build log.
claim: The paper builds with every equation and figure on the page, no section deleted, and results derived.
rubric: Every equation and figure fits inside the page.
No section was deleted; anything removed is commented out in the source.
Each result the edit touched is derived, not asserted.
Joe's prose is unchanged outside the edited spots.
The reply shows the build command and its output.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
